name: instructblip_three_stage_training_plan
description: Three-stage training curriculum for an InstructBLIP-style VLM. Stage 1 learns visual-language representations in the Q-Former; Stage 2 aligns the Q-Former output with the frozen LLM through the projector; Stage 3 performs instruction adaptation with QLoRA while keeping the Q-Former frozen.

image_encoder.reason: Keep the pretrained visual representation stable.

qformer_protection.principle: Q-Former is the learned visual-language representation interface. After Stage 1 it should only be adjusted very conservatively in Stage 2b, then frozen for all of Stage 3.

stages.name: representation_alignment
stages.goal: Learn visual-language representation inside the Q-Former.

stages.name: modality_bridge_alignment
stages.goal: Stabilize and align the bridge from Q-Former latent space to the frozen LLM embedding space.

subphases.name: stage_2a_projector_warmup
subphases.goal: Warm up the randomly initialized projector without allowing the Q-Former or LLM to move.

subphases.name: stage_2b_joint_bridge_alignment
subphases.goal: Allow only a very small Q-Former adjustment while the projector learns the main mapping into the LLM-compatible representation.

stages.name: instruction_adaptation
stages.goal: Adapt multimodal behavior through QLoRA while preserving the Q-Former visual-language representation learned earlier.

qformer_policy.reason: Stage 1 already learned visual-language representation and Stage 2 already allowed the only intended small alignment adjustment.

subphases.name: stage_3a_qlora_warmup
subphases.goal: Introduce QLoRA conservatively while keeping the Q-Former fully frozen.

subphases.name: stage_3b_full_instruction_tuning
subphases.goal: Shift most downstream adaptation responsibility to QLoRA. Q-Former remains frozen permanently.

implementation_notes.stage2a: 1000 steps is a conservative default for projector warm-up.
implementation_notes.stage2b: Keep Q-Former LR at least ~20x lower than the projector LR.
implementation_notes.stage3: Do not unfreeze Q-Former again. Downstream instruction adaptation should primarily be absorbed by QLoRA, with the projector using a smaller LR.
